label: TCR loci / TLX3

sections.text: TCR loci encode T-cell receptor chains and contain lineage-active regulatory elements.
TLX3 encodes a homeobox transcription factor involved in neuronal differentiation.

T-cell-receptor regulatory rearrangements can activate TLX3 expression in developing T cells, disrupting normal lineage-specific transcription. This is an enhancer-driven oncogenic mechanism in T-ALL rather than an asserted chimeric TCR protein.
